blocks.text: Cafeteria is functioning in the campus adjacent to the Book Store for the benefit of students & staff. Spacious, airy & trendy canteen & bakery offers ample scope for students to break free from their tough schedules and enjoy appetizing food in an extremely casual yet pleasant ambience.
